title: I let players type any order. Someone ordered AI spies.
author: dkackman11
selftext:
A player in The Fragile Republic ordered Brandt to make AI spies and Seydel to research a super soldier serum. They were testing the limits. It worked.



I made the game by talking with Savi, Spawn's AI companion. My design call was to let players write their own orders and invent things like a personal guard, rather than stick to preset answers. People can refuse. Orders they accept keep working for quarters.



The promise book is the sting. When a promise comes due, it comes back with the person's face and a stamp: KEPT or BROKEN.



free, play it in your browser: [https://www.spawn.co/@dkackman/the-fragile-republic](https://www.spawn.co/@dkackman/the-fragile-republic)
